info.title: Contacts Management API
info.description:
A comprehensive API for managing contacts with authentication, email features, and image uploads.

Features:
- User authentication with JWT tokens
- Contact CRUD operations with pagination, sorting, and filtering
- Password reset via email
- Photo upload for contacts using Cloudinary
- Session management
